description: Use when a request is in phase needs_clarification. Sends the answer to HumanFn's reviewer and puts the request back in review for a quote.

access_token.description: The access token returned with the request (rqt_…); it authorizes access to this request.

answer.description: The answer to the reviewer's question, from the customer.

request_id.description: The request ID returned by request_execution (req_…).

name: answer_clarification
title: Answer HumanFn's clarifying question
